commercial.transport: Arranged by seller; amount requires owner confirmation for every quotation
commercial.installation: Customer scope unless separately requested and owner-approved

warranty.Kirloskar: 18 months from factory dispatch, 12 months from commissioning, or 3600 operating hours, whichever is earlier; extended terms only under the applicable KOEL policy.
warranty.Ashok Leyland: Engine: 60 months from Ashok Leyland engine sale or 8000 operating hours, whichever is earlier; other components follow their manufacturers' warranties.
warranty.Cummins: Use the warranty stated in the applicable current Cummins product/offer document; owner review required before quotation.

qualification.qualified: Contactable buyer with location, purchase/rental intent, application and capacity or equipment-load details confirmed.
qualification.highPriority: Required within 30 days, rental enquiry, repeat buyer, confirmed budget/purchase intent, or urgent breakdown/replacement.
qualification.readyForQuotation: Requirement and sizing confirmed and owner has approved price, transport, installation scope, availability and delivery wording.
qualification.siteVisit: Capacity cannot be safely determined remotely, multiple motors start together, complex industrial load, installation/access constraints, acoustic/exhaust/cabling work, or rating above 250 kVA.
qualification.ownerCallback: Rental, negotiation, discount, finance, non-standard terms, stock/delivery commitment, competitor matching, complaint, or uncertain technical recommendation.
qualification.invalid: Unreachable/invalid phone, spam, unrelated request, or no generator requirement after verification.
qualification.duplicate: Same normalized phone already exists; attach the new source event to the existing lead.
qualification.outsideServiceArea: Installation location is outside the configured service-area list; owner decides whether to proceed.
qualification.notInterested: Customer clearly declines and has not asked for a later callback.
